verdict.rationale: Cline documents diff-based review and one-click undo/checkpoints for every agent edit, plus auto-commit git worktrees per Kanban card, which together support reviewing and rolling back automation actions. However, there's no explicit evidence of versioning for the automations themselves (e.g., skills, scheduled cron agents, subagent configs) beyond code-level git checkpoints. Missing for 10: explicit versioning/rollback of automation definitions (skills, schedules, cron jobs) and independent corroboration of the checkpoint/undo feature in practice.
